verdict.rationale: Channel3 exposes a cross-merchant product search API covering 100M+ products from 25,000+ brands, with text, image and URL search and filters. Access is via SDK, CLI and MCP. Credentials are self-service: API keys are free to create, MCP use needs no API key, and agents can pay via MPP with no signup. A developer building on it corroborates that access works without a private partnership. Community reports of poor result relevance concern search quality, not the ability to query programmatically, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404) and independent evidence that result relevance is reliable for agent use.
